text:
It's true that reciting the Hanuman Chalisa without understanding its meaning and without attempting to integrate its teachings into our behavior may not fully honor its significance. Some of the qualities such as "Eknishta bhakti" (unwavering devotion), "आतुर" (eager and enthusiastic), "Mahavir" (mighty and courageous), and "Parakrami" (brave and valorous), are all admirable attributes that we can aspire to cultivate within ourselves.

Hanumanji's devotion to Lord Rama, his selflessness, courage, and unwavering commitment to his duties serve as powerful examples for all of us . His actions, as depicted in the Ramayana, emphasize the importance of loyalty, humility, and service to others. The instances of Hanumanji bringing the Sanjeevani herb without any hesitation or concern about the challenges involved, as well as his fearless leap across the ocean to deliver Sri Ram's ring, demonstrate his dedication, focus, and willingness to go to great lengths to fulfill his Guru’s tasks. Hanumanji is Tattpar and आतुर in doing his “गुरु कार्य”. In Similar manner we should be Quick and आतुर for doing “गुरु कार्य”or fulfilling the responsibilities. It reminds us that true devotion lies in surrendering to your bosses or “Guru”. Leaving your bosses for selfish needs is not understanding Hanumanji.

 This means not only reciting the verses but also internalizing their meanings and applying them in our thoughts, words, and actions. We should imbibe those qualities in us.

I am writing without any selfish motives. Requesting you to give a thought.

Hari Om Tat Sat.
